spells/luminous-assassin-2930.name: Luminous Assassin
spells/luminous-assassin-2930.effectSummary: Functions as Lesser Luminous Assassin except for the summoned assassin's statistics. It appears above one creature within range, makes an initial falling attack while that target is treated as flat-footed, and is then placed in an adjacent square that can hold it. Afterward it acts after your turn each round, intelligently attacks and pursues the original target, and needs no direction. You can order it only to attack creatures or wait; you can redirect it as a free action only after the original target dies or escapes. It and all its possessions vanish when the spell ends. Its source stat block is a CR 3 neutral Medium human rogue 3 (human, extraplanar): initiative +6; Listen +6, Spot +6; Common, Dwarven, and Elven; AC 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14, with Dodge and Mobility; 16 hp; evasion; Fort +3, Ref +6, Will +2; speed 30 ft.; masterwork rapier +4 (1d6+1, 18-20) and masterwork shortbow +5 (1d6+1, x3); base attack +2, grapple +3; sneak attack +2d6; potions of cure moderate wounds and darkvision; Str 12, Dex 15, Con 13, Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 8; feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Mobility; Appraise +8, Balance +8, Disable Device +8, Escape Artist +8, Hide +8, Listen +6, Move Silently +8, Open Lock +8, Search +8, Spot +6, Tumble +8; and possessions of masterwork studded leather, masterwork rapier, masterwork buckler, cloak of resistance +1, masterwork shortbow, and 200 gp. Focus: a serrated dagger.

spells/luminous-assassin-greater-2931.name: Luminous Assassin, Greater

It can only be commanded to attack creatures or wait, and can be redirected as a free action only after the original target dies or escapes. It and its possessions vanish when the spell ends. spells/summon-clockwork-mender-swarm-200.name: Summon Clockwork Mender Swarm
spells/summon-clockwork-mender-swarm-200.effectSummary: Functions as Summon Monster I except that it always summons one clockwork mender swarm rather than choosing from the Summon Monster I list. The swarm appears where designated and acts immediately on your turn; it attacks opponents to the best of its ability and, when you can communicate with it, can be directed to attack particular enemies or take other permitted actions. This spell specifically allows directing the swarm to attack, use its swarm repair ability, or use its swarm sacrifice ability. As inherited from Summon Monster I, the summoned creature cannot summon or otherwise conjure another creature, cannot use teleportation or planar-travel abilities, and cannot be summoned into an environment that cannot support it. The spell is Lawful, has a 1-full-round casting time, Close range, one-swarm effect, duration 1 round/level (D), no saving throw, and no spell resistance. Arcane focus: a broken metal gear. The external clockwork mender swarm stat block and the detailed mechanics of swarm repair and swarm sacrifice are deliberately left as named references rather than invented or expanded from memory.
